rule: Closed owner concerns. Not a transcript. Each row is the question, the adopted answer, and the live ids. Plan is factory/packages.json. Conversation is not stored.

concerns.ask: How to run the control plane without Claude Code, on a local machine and in the cloud.
concerns.answer: Grok stays the control plane. The token is the writer. Claude Code absent is the default. Local: PC seat. Cloud: git-bus if the autobuild PC is on, else a Codespace. Do not remap this session onto the token.

concerns.ask: Keep it flexible for whatever the human project manager picks.
concerns.answer: Live picks in factory/project.json. Allowed ids in factory/runtimes.json. Contribute, isolate, writer, cache, and helpMode are catalog rows. Parent defaults stay owner-only.

concerns.ask: Owner needs a local/cloud view of progress and a visual of the app dashboard as it is built, clickable only where landed.
concerns.answer: Owner console: Setup plus Floor. Local and cloud are lenses. Chassis tiles take a click iff built. Spec in factory/CONSOLE.md. Running app is the Grok App Builder project named GROK Factory.

concerns.ask: Save tokens without weakening the end product.
concerns.answer: Cut the write. Do not cut judgment. Lean mix: sweep on ordinary lanes, keystone only when named, review every loop, never the author. Optional scripts have no weights and are not a required third actor.

concerns.ask: Retire the session. Nothing that matters may live only in the chat. Record the conversation, the concerns, the answers, and the plan.
concerns.answer: Git is memory. Conversation is not stored (no SESSION_LOG, no handoff.md). Outcomes live as decisions and CONSOLE.md. Closed concerns live here. Plan is factory/packages.json. A new concern is a new id. Never reuse D-09. Read live main before any write to the parent.

concerns.ask: Adopt a proposed feedback loop: a spend log, a redundancy distiller, a prompt-prefix gate step, a token cap in CI, a replacement writer Action, and five architectural sparks.
concerns.answer: Rejected on verification. The spend cap stays the envelope's and hitting it is a return. Prefix stability stays the packet's ordering, measured by cachedTokens in the return, not by a hash of BOARD.md. Lessons stay traps.yaml behind spark.mjs, which has shape, an open cap and a TTL. The writer runner stays writer.yml plus ghaWriter.mjs. The one gap, that nothing sums spend across returns, is open as S07.
